fields.headline: Welcome aboard, {{first_name}}!
fields.intro:
Thanks for joining Acme. You now have everything you need to plan, ship and report on your work in one calm place.

Here’s how to get value in your first ten minutes.
fields.s1Text: Give it a name and pick a template. It takes about a minute.
fields.s2Text: Projects are better together. Your first five seats are free.
fields.s3Text: Sync Slack, GitHub and Google Calendar so updates flow in automatically.
fields.noteText: I started Acme because planning work shouldn’t feel like work. If anything is confusing, or you just want to say hi, reply to this email. It comes straight to me.
